verdict.rationale: Proton's official CLI announcement says the CLI is built to retrieve secrets across scripts, deployments and CI/CD pipelines, and supports CRUD on vaults and items, so the product can run headlessly for automation. The evidence is a single launch blog post rather than in-depth reference docs. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or headless authentication (e.g. service tokens), concrete CI integration examples or reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
